System Architecture Overview

section.p: Result: If an image is larger than 100 × 100 pixels, the converter generates an element with the placement attribute as break and wraps it in a element. The converter also generates the element from the image filename. The <fig> element is placed outside the preceding <p> element so that the image is represented as a standalone figure.
